abilities.name: Collect host identity
abilities.description: Collect the isolated agent identity for lab telemetry.

abilities.name: Collect system information
abilities.description: Collect kernel information from the isolated target.

abilities.name: Collect process list
abilities.description: Collect processes visible inside the isolated target.

abilities.name: Collect workspace listing
abilities.description: List only the explicitly mounted lab workspace.

abilities.name: Collect local accounts
abilities.description: List local account entries. /etc/passwd holds no secrets; shadow is not readable by the unprivileged agent.

abilities.name: Collect container context
abilities.description: Determine whether the agent is running inside a container.

abilities.name: Collect network interfaces
abilities.description: Read interface statistics. In the default lab this shows only loopback, evidencing that the sandbox has no network.

abilities.name: Collect installed packages
abilities.description: List packages present in the isolated image.

abilities.name: Inspect a discovered process
abilities.description: Read the status of a process discovered earlier. Cannot run until a pid is known, so it depends on the process listing.

abilities.name: Inspect a discovered package
abilities.description: List the files a package installed. Cannot run until a package name is known, so it depends on the package listing.

abilities.name: Inspect a discovered account
abilities.description: Resolve the uid and groups of an account discovered earlier. Cannot run until an account name is known.
